auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: workspace, library, reports, and settings routes require a signed-in user
plan and fixture records are owned by the signed-in user who created them
a signed-out visitor cannot see saved plans or fixtures
one signed-in user cannot read, update, export, or print another user's plans or fixtures

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: Public entry page for Lumen Layouts with authentication entry points and navigation to the protected application after sign-in.

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: Protected interactive SVG floor-planning workspace with plan switching, canvas pan and zoom, fixture placement, inspector editing, undo, redo, and save/reload behavior.

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: Protected standalone reference page showing the available in-code fixture library used by the workspace.

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: Protected reporting page for previewing, exporting, and printing saved plan summaries.

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: Protected account settings route showing signed-in account information and sign-out control.

states.error: authentication failed message is visible when sign-in fails
states.loading: auth action in progress indicator is visible while sign-in or sign-up is submitted
states.success: the workspace route becomes available after sign-in
states.validation: email must look like an email and password is required

states.empty: no plans yet message is visible with a create plan control
states.error: could not load or save plans message is visible when persistence fails
states.loading: loading plans indicator is visible while saved plans load
states.success: created plans appear in the sidebar
states.validation: plan name is required before a plan can be created

states.empty: empty canvas instruction says to drag a fixture from the library
states.error: could not save canvas changes message is visible when persistence fails
states.loading: loading fixtures indicator is visible while active plan fixtures load
states.success: saved indicator is visible after fixture or viewport changes persist
states.validation: fixture position, rotation, brightness, pan, and zoom fields show validation messages for non-numeric values

states.empty: select a fixture message is visible when no fixture is selected
states.error: could not update fixture message is visible when saving fails
states.loading: selected fixture loading indicator is visible while details resolve
states.success: updated fixture values remain displayed in the inspector
states.validation: brightness must be within the displayed allowed range and rotation must be numeric

states.empty: no saved plans to report message is visible when the user has no plans
states.error: could not generate report message is visible when export or print generation fails
states.loading: loading report data indicator is visible while plans and fixtures load
states.success: export confirmation or print-ready summary is visible after the action

states.empty: no fixtures configured message is visible if the in-code library is unavailable
states.error: fixture library unavailable message is visible if the page cannot render fixture options
states.loading: fixture library loading indicator is visible while the page initializes
states.success: fixture categories and fixture names are visible
states.validation: not applicable because the library route is read-only

states.empty: authentication prompt is visible if no current user is available
states.error: could not sign out message is visible when sign-out fails
states.loading: loading account settings indicator is visible while current user data loads
states.success: signed-out state is visible after sign-out
states.validation: not applicable for read-only account email display and sign-out

summary: An authenticated Lumen Layouts application where users create durable SVG floor plans, place and edit fixtures on a pan/zoom workspace, undo and redo changes, switch plans, export summaries, and print reports.

deferred.reason: the request requires user-owned durable plans but does not request simultaneous collaboration
the request requires exporting a plan summary and printing it, not generating high-fidelity PDF drawings
the request asks users to drag fixtures from a library, not create or manage library definitions
the request does not require uploading floor images, logos, or custom fixture graphics

entities.name: plan
relationships: a plan belongs to one signed-in user

entities.name: fixture
relationships: a fixture belongs to one plan
a fixture is created from one in-code fixture library item

steps.expect: the Lumen Layouts workspace is visible with a plan sidebar, SVG canvas area, fixture library panel, and inspector panel

steps.action: create a new plan and give it a name
steps.expect: a new plan tab or sidebar item shows the entered plan name and the canvas becomes available

steps.action: drag a fixture from the library onto the canvas
steps.expect: the fixture appears on the SVG canvas and is selected with its details shown in the inspector

steps.action: edit the selected fixture position, rotation, and brightness in the inspector
steps.expect: the selected fixture visibly moves or updates on the canvas and the inspector displays the new position, rotation, and brightness values

steps.action: use undo and redo for the latest fixture edit
steps.expect: undo visibly restores the previous fixture state and redo visibly reapplies the edited fixture state
the canvas view changes and a visible zoom indicator shows the updated zoom level
the same plan reopens with the saved fixture and canvas viewport state still visible

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates, edits, saves, and reloads a floor plan
acceptance: a created plan remains visible after a full page reload
a fixture added to the canvas remains visible after a full page reload
edited fixture position, rotation, and brightness values remain visible after a full page reload

steps.expect: the plan sidebar lists the previously created plan
the second plan appears in the plan sidebar and becomes the active canvas

steps.action: select the original plan from the plan sidebar
steps.expect: the original plan name is highlighted and its saved fixture layout is shown on the canvas

steps.action: select the second plan from the plan sidebar
steps.expect: the second plan name is highlighted and its own canvas state is shown

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates a second plan and switches between saved plans
acceptance: switching plans changes the visible active plan name
switching back to the original plan restores its own fixture layout

steps.expect: the canvas, fixture list, inspector fields, pan controls, zoom controls, undo control, and redo control are reachable with visible labels

steps.action: select a fixture using the keyboard-accessible fixture list
steps.expect: the selected fixture is highlighted on the canvas and its inspector fields are focused or visible

steps.action: change fixture coordinates using keyboard-accessible inspector text fields
steps.expect: the fixture position changes on the canvas and the updated coordinate values remain displayed

steps.action: change fixture rotation and brightness using keyboard-accessible inspector text fields
steps.expect: the fixture visual state updates and the inspector displays the new rotation and brightness values

steps.action: pan and zoom using keyboard-accessible controls
steps.expect: the canvas viewport changes and the visible zoom indicator updates

journeys.title: A signed-in user performs canvas actions using keyboard-accessible alternatives
acceptance: a fixture can be selected without dragging on the canvas
fixture position can be changed through labeled keyboard-accessible controls
canvas zoom can be changed through a labeled keyboard-accessible control

steps.expect: the Lumen Layouts fixture library is visible as a standalone page
fixture options such as lights, counters, walls, doors, tables, and seating are visible with names and descriptions

journeys.title: A signed-in user views the standalone fixture library route
acceptance: the library route is separate from the workspace route
the library route shows fixture options that can also be used in the workspace

steps.expect: the reports page is visible with a plan selector and summary area

steps.action: select a saved plan for reporting
steps.expect: the report preview shows the selected plan name and a fixture count
a downloadable plan summary file is produced and the page shows an exported confirmation
a print-ready summary view is shown with the plan name, fixture count, and fixture details

journeys.title: A signed-in user exports and prints a plan summary
acceptance: the exported summary includes the selected plan name
the exported summary includes fixture type and edited fixture values
the print-ready view includes the selected plan name and fixture details

steps.expect: the settings page is visible with the signed-in account email and a sign-out control
the app shows a signed-out state or authentication screen

steps.action: open the workspace route while signed out
steps.expect: the workspace data is not visible and an authentication prompt is shown

journeys.title: A signed-in user views settings and signed-out visitors cannot access workspace data
acceptance: settings are available on a route separate from workspace, library, and reports
a signed-out visitor cannot see saved plans
a signed-out visitor is prompted to authenticate before using the workspace

acceptance.statement: a submitted plan name is visible in the workspace sidebar after a full page reload
a fixture dragged onto the SVG canvas is visible after a full page reload
edited fixture x, y, rotation, and brightness values remain visible in the inspector after a full page reload
undo visibly restores the prior fixture state and redo visibly reapplies the changed fixture state
selecting different plans in the sidebar changes the active canvas and highlighted plan name
keyboard-accessible controls can select a fixture and update its position without dragging on the canvas
the reports export action produces a downloadable summary that includes the selected plan name and fixture details
the reports print action shows a print-ready summary containing the selected plan name and fixture details
a signed-out visitor opening /workspace sees an authentication prompt and no saved plan data
